calculation.description: Compute each asset's lagged five-day return relative to the cross-sectional mean, reverse the residual, and amplify the reversal when lagged cross-asset dispersion is high. All inputs are shifted to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Full sample clears the benchmark absolute IC and ICIR gates. 2027-28 was strongest (IC 0.053163, ICIR 0.176433); recent 180-day performance weakened (IC 0.011031, ICIR 0.034872), so use capped ensemble weight and revalidate promptly.
validation.validation_method: Daily Spearman cross-sectional IC against forward returns, with at least 8 valid instruments per date; 15-instrument universe used.
